label: Bible Study
prompt: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his _____ was not arrayed like one of these.
verse: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
note: Consider the lilies — Israel's most splendid king couldn't match a wildflower's outfit.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the _____.
verse: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
note: Patience is the bridge between doing God's will and receiving His promise.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden _____;
verse: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
note: John turned to see who was speaking and saw seven golden candlesticks — the seven churches (Revelation 1:20).

label: Deep Water
prompt: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a _____ from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
verse: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
note: Moses promised a prophet like himself; Peter applies it to Jesus in Acts 3:22.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a _____ savour.
verse: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
note: Christ's self-giving as 'a sweetsmelling savour' — offering language straight out of Leviticus, in one KJV compound.
